candidates: When modifying file content via chained `String.replace()` calls that target the same regex pattern (a common pattern in `scripts/tasks/sandbox-parts.ts` and similar codegen/sandbox-setup scripts), do not use multiple sequential `.replace()` calls for the same match point. Each call re-scans the already-modified string and will silently overwrite insertions made by earlier passes. Instead, combine all conditional insertions at the same match point into a single `.replace()` callback that builds the complete replacement string in one pass.
